meta.title: OpenPI · Task delegation & return
meta.subtitle: Parent-model tool call → independent Pi session → observable status and one-shot completion

components.label: Parent Pi session
components.explanation: This overview starts at the parent model's subagent_spawn call, not at a network task endpoint. The caller receives an ID after startup, can inspect or explicitly wait, and otherwise gets a follow-up that triggers a parent turn. Pi's own user-input and provider internals are external dependencies, not implemented in this source slice.

sources.label: Spawn returns child ID and metadata
Explicit wait returns result and status

components.label: Subagent tool boundary
components.explanation: subagent_spawn accepts prompt/name plus optional role, working directory, model, reasoning effort, isolation and output schema. It validates cwd, narrows tools to the parent/role/plan-mode policy, resolves project trust, and invokes manager.spawn through the shared Effect ManagedRuntime. Default model and thinking level inherit from the parent. subagent_check/list read manager snapshots; subagent_wait explicitly synchronizes without making waiting the default.

components.label: Subagent manager
components.explanation: Owns child IDs, pool reservations, shared admission leases and per-child scopes. backend.spawn starts the session; a scoped event pump folds activity into mutable snapshots. RunSettled records done/completed or error/failed|interrupted, final/partial text and evidence. Subscribers and waiters are notified; active wait interest marks a result consumed. A stop timeout can be terminal for presentation while execution remains uncertain, so admission is retained rather than assuming the child stopped.

sources.label: Admission, backend spawn and event pump
Wait loop and uncertain stop deadline

components.label: Pi backend + child session
components.explanation: The adapter calls createAgentSession with SessionManager.create(cwd), child resources/trust, resolved model, inherited thinking level and enforced tool policy. It subscribes to Pi lifecycle/activity events and starts session.prompt(task.prompt), returning a stream rather than waiting for model completion. Terminal success requires the exact prompt Promise to settle with lifecycle evidence; errors, interruption and missing structured output are distinct outcomes. Session persistence is explicitly recorded as unknown in direct evidence. The Pi dependency's implementation is outside this checkout.

components.label: Completion delivery inbox
components.explanation: The extension wires manager.onSettled to append a finished record and defer a snapshot copy unless an active wait/cancel consumed it. The inbox claims and acknowledges batches, retrying synchronous delivery failures. It flushes immediately when the parent is idle or at the parent's agent_settled boundary. An explicit wait consumes pending results so a queued automatic notification does not duplicate that delivery. This is an in-process coordinator, not an external message broker or demonstrated durable queue.

components.label: Result projection & dispatch
components.sublabel: Bound output; append and wake parent
components.explanation: Automatic delivery builds model-visible output plus completion metadata and a separate display projection, appends a subagent-result entry, and calls pi.sendMessage with deliverAs: followUp and triggerTurn: true. The shared projection used by waits and automatic delivery preserves head/tail context for long results and attempts to save an immutable text artifact for native read. Artifact write failure is explicit and does not erase execution success. These files are auxiliary result caches, not the manager's live status source of truth.

cards.title: Task acceptance & independence
items: The parent model chooses delegation; spawn returns an ID after startup, not the final answer.
Child tools are a fail-closed parent/role intersection; model and thinking inherit unless overridden.
Default cwd is shared. Optional worktree isolation must succeed or spawn fails; it is not a process sandbox.

cards.title: Three caller-facing views
items: check/list: read live snapshots; wait: explicit synchronization with bounded result output.
Unawaited completion: inbox → follow-up → parent model turn, without a new user prompt.
Status subscribers also feed TUI and Web projections (index.ts:599–625), not a second execution state store.
